description: The article editor: a WordPress-style create/edit screen at /admin/articles/new and /admin/articles/[id]/edit with every article field (title, auto slug, excerpt, author picker, category picker, publishedAt, SEO title/description, FAQs, featured + inline images), a rich-text body editor producing valid Portable Text, and image upload to Sanity assets as the logged-in user. Depends on FEAT-001 (auth gate, admin client, portable-text utils).
steps: Create app/admin/articles/new/page.tsx and app/admin/articles/[id]/edit/page.tsx. Both render a shared components/admin/ArticleEditor.tsx client component; the edit page passes the document id so the editor loads the existing doc (prefer the draft `drafts.<id>` if it exists, else the published doc) via the admin client and hydrates the internal model using the parsers from lib/portable-text.ts.

In ArticleEditor.tsx build a Studio-like two-column layout: main column = Title (large input; slug auto-derives from title using a slugify that mirrors Sanity's behavior - lowercase, spaces->hyphens, strip non-url chars, maxLength 96, with a manual edit/override field), Excerpt (textarea, live char count, max 300 enforced), Body editor (FEAT-003 supplies the table part; this feature supplies the rich-text part), FAQs (repeatable {question, answer} rows with add/remove). Right sidebar = Publish panel (FEAT-003 wiring), Featured Image uploader, Author picker, Category picker, Published At (datetime-local), SEO Title (max 70, char count), SEO Description (max 160, char count). Match the field set + validation limits in sanity/schemas/article.ts exactly.

Build the rich-text body editor in components/admin/RichTextEditor.tsx ('use client'). Prefer a dependency-free contentEditable-based editor (no new npm dep, given INTEGRATIONS_ONLY): a toolbar with Normal/H2/H3/H4/Quote block styles, Bold/Italic/Underline/Code inline marks, bullet + numbered list, Link (prompt for href, stored as a link annotation), and an 'Insert image' + 'Insert table' action. On every change, serialize the editor content to the Portable Text array using lib/portable-text.ts builders (blocks with correct style, spans with marks arrays, link markDefs with _key referenced by span marks, list blocks with listItem+level:1, image blocks, tableBlock). Generate _key for every block/span/markDef. Ensure output round-trips through components/news/PortableTextRenderer.tsx identically (h2-h4, blockquote, strong/em/underline/code, links, bullet/number lists, inline images with alt+caption). If a contentEditable approach proves too fragile to serialize reliably, an acceptable alternative is a structured block-list editor (each block is a typed row: paragraph/heading/quote/list/image/table with its own controls) that maps 1:1 to Portable Text - this is often MORE reliable for exact-shape output; choose whichever yields correct, valid Portable Text and document the choice.

Implement author + category pickers as select/combobox components (components/admin/ReferencePicker.tsx). Fetch options with the admin client: authors `*[_type=='author']|order(name asc){_id, name}`, categories `*[_type=='category']|order(title asc){_id, title}`. Store the selection as a Sanity reference { _type:'reference', _ref:<_id> } (matches article.ts author/category reference fields). Show a hint when no authors/categories exist yet (must be created in Studio or a future admin screen).

Implement image upload in components/admin/ImageUploader.tsx used for BOTH the featured image (mainImage: image + alt) and inline body images (image + alt + caption, options hotspot). Upload the file via the authenticated admin client: client.assets.upload('image', file) which runs as the logged-in user; on success store the returned asset as { _type:'image', asset:{ _type:'reference', _ref: result._id }, alt, caption? }. Show a preview using the existing urlFor()/@sanity/image-url builder (from lib/sanity.ts) or the returned asset url. Handle upload errors and large files gracefully. Featured image stores alt only; inline images store alt + optional caption to match article.ts.

Wire client-side validation matching the schema: title required, slug required, excerpt required (<=300), author required, category required, publishedAt required; seoTitle<=70, seoDescription<=160; FAQ question+answer required when a FAQ row exists. Show inline errors and disable Save/Publish until required fields are valid. Do not yet perform the actual write (that is FEAT-003) - expose an onSave(model, mode) callback that FEAT-003 implements, but structure the component so save wiring drops in cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: /admin/articles/new renders an empty editor; /admin/articles/[id]/edit loads an existing article (draft preferred) and hydrates all fields including body blocks, table blocks, images, author, category, FAQs.
Title auto-generates an editable slug; excerpt/SEO title/SEO description enforce 300/70/160 char limits with visible counts.

Rich-text editor can produce every supported block/mark: H2/H3/H4, blockquote, bold/italic/underline/code, links (href annotation), bullet + numbered lists, inline images - and the serialized Portable Text matches the shape consumed by components/news/PortableTextRenderer.tsx and produced by data/sample-news.ts.
Author and Category pickers list Sanity docs and store proper reference objects {_type:'reference', _ref}.
Featured and inline images upload via client.assets.upload (as the logged-in user, no master token) and are stored as image objects with asset reference + alt (+ caption for inline).
Client-side validation blocks save when required fields are missing or limits exceeded.
No new npm dependency added (contentEditable/structured editor is hand-rolled); if unavoidable, added to package.json AND package-lock.json.
verification: Static review of serialized output against PortableTextBlock (lib/sanity-queries.ts), PortableTextRenderer.tsx component map, and data/sample-news.ts textBlock/buildBody: block _type/style, span marks, markDefs link _key linkage, list listItem+level.
Confirm reference objects and image objects match sanity/schemas/article.ts field definitions.
Confirm all interactive components have 'use client' and imports resolve to existing deps/files.

Rely on GitHub Actions CI for next build + next lint; ensure no unescaped JSX entities, no unused vars, and usage is either next/image or has a deliberate eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element with a reason.
